author: PC Gamer
text:
Newzoo analyst expects Grand Theft Auto to turn around a rough year for console gaming: 'without GTA 6 the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026'
There's a lot riding on Jason and Lucia.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Miami Heat shows off its 'Vice City hardwood' ahead of the big Grand Theft Auto 6 basketball game
They've got new uniforms, too. They're pretty cool.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Caves of Qud's first DLC is forcing its devs to ask important questions: 'How does a crab get high?'
Qud's co-creators discuss dogs with guns, handless tattooing, and the tragedy of a sinning tree.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Jensen Huang isn't coming back, says Nvidia board
Huang announced that he would accept reinstatement, but Nvidia isn't offering it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Tomb Raider developer makes fifth round of layoffs in less than 2 years
Crystal Dynamics confirmed that eight people have been let go in a "necessary business decision."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sci-fi RPG Exodus gets even more Mass Effect-like with its female lead, who they are calling Femjun
Yup, it's official.

author: PC Gamer
text:
We got 8 Game Awards nominations for GTA 6 before GTA 6
The Game Awards says its judges "may be provided with advance or pre-release access to games for critical evaluation."

author: PC Gamer
text:
I have replaced (most) cars in GTA 5 with bicycles and also my own clones
Can't have one without the other.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve-sanctioned Half-Life remake Black Mesa gets a mondo update and a Steam Deck verified badge
And cubemaps. Which, thank god.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Civilization dev Firaxis reportedly lays off a third of its staff, studio head departs
A new XCOM game in development at Firaxis has reportedly struggled and missed a major milestone earlier this year.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Jensen Huang says he would come back as Nvidia's CEO if America needs him – a technique I now intend to use at my next job interview
"I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO."

author: PC Gamer
text:
'I want to be clear, I want people to have a lot of RAM' says Sam Altman, weeks after seeming to say the opposite
Altman claims his remarks were taken out of context, but has since elaborated on his stance.

author: PC Gamer
text:
TCL CSOT's new OLED panels might not only be cheaper, but also have high refresh rates and hassle-free pixel burn-in compensation
They might not even need you to wait for pixel compensation cycles.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Twitchers rejoice: GTA 6 will have 62 different species of birds, though that falls a bit short of the over 500 native species found in Florida
They better have a Snowy Plover.

author: PC Gamer
text:
AMD introduces Capacity Aware Scheduling to the Linux kernel, which sure is the thing I'd do if I were introducing Zen 6 LP cores next year
Any way that more efficiently uses cores has the thumbs up from me.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia tightens up control of its own national security policies as it cozies up to US government with new board-controlled committee
Another committee for the committee pile.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard drops the hammer on WoW: Forever players who exploited a now-hotfixed grind to rake in thousands of gold
Blizzard says "significant abusers" of the bug will lose their ill-gotten gains and possibly have their accounts suspended.

author: PC Gamer
text:
US agencies confirm criminal investigation into Megaspeed - datacenter company is in a colossal tangle over Nvidia chips
Investigation into Megaspeed first started in 2024.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'They would never stop working on this game': GTA 6's development could've gone on for longer just because 'it's really hard to close it down'
There's always room for a bit more polish.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Modder beats Valve to the punch adding Steam Controller tracking for the Steam Frame
"I'll try to maintain this at least until Valve releases official tracking support for the Steam Controller."

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 release times: How far behind the first launch will GTA 6 unlock in your time zone?
Grand Theft Auto 6 is on a rolling launch, which means everyone's getting access at different times.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ex-Call of Duty live service manager joins EA as the new GM of Battlefield
This has ignited some fears within the community of the COD-ification of Battlefield.

author: PC Gamer
text:
007 First Light soundtrack is up for a Grammy award—but that theme song I didn't like isn't included for some reason
The 007 First Light score is competing with four other videogame soundtracks for the prestigious music industry trophy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gabe Newell stuns superyacht enthusiasts by treating crew like human beings: 'That is something we've never really seen before in our industry'
The crew retention on Newell's boats is six times the average on other superyachts.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Trump supports Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, but it doesn't sound like the board is interested
The US president doesn't seem too concerned about the potential risks to US national security: "I think he learned a big lesson, I guess."
